rows.source: OPSS Product Safety Alerts, Reports and Recalls
rows.verified: The catalogue distinguishes product safety alerts, product safety reports and product recalls.

rows.source: OPSS Product Safety Alerts, Reports and Recalls
rows.verified: Risk filters include serious, high, medium, low and not provided.

rows.source: OPSS Product Safety Alerts, Reports and Recalls
rows.verified: The official catalogue supports filtering across product categories including electrical equipment, toys, PPE, machinery and gas appliances.

rows.source: OPSS Product Safety Alerts, Reports and Recalls
rows.verified: Measure filters cover recalls, withdrawals, marketplace removals, border rejection, destruction, modification and consumer warnings.

rows.source: OPSS Product Safety Alerts, Reports and Recalls
rows.verified: Reports can be filtered by recall or alert date.

rows.source: OPSS Product Safety Alerts, Reports and Recalls
rows.verified: The catalogue offers email notifications and a feed.
